questions.q: Halfway through the science unit, what has truly made sense to you so far?
questions.answer: One example: DNA holds more information than anything people have made, and since information always traces back to a mind, it makes sense to me that DNA has an author.

questions.q: Do you ever nod along in a lesson while secretly thinking you don't get it?
questions.answer: Yeah, sometimes. It's okay to say so here; honest questions are welcome, and we can slow down and go over an idea again until it really makes sense.

questions.q: How does comparing DNA to a book help you picture what DNA really is?
questions.answer: A book is full of information, and every book has an author. DNA holds even more information than anything we've made, so it points to an author of life.
